english.title: Fail to comply with requirement for movement of consignment in relation to customs supervision / notification of arrival

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 17 and 42 of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
consignment of products and CHED required that consignment to be taken under supervision from border control post to specific destination in Great Britain
failed to ensure that movement was under customs supervision as specified in CHED OR
being the occupier of the destination premises failed to immediately notify the appropriate authority of its arrival
